Ray Marching: Signed Distance Fields, Sphere Tracing, and SDF Shading
Mar 7, 2026Ray marching is a rendering method that finds surfaces by moving along a ray in repeated steps. It often appears in procedural rendering because a scene can be described by functions instead of a stored mesh or a set of closed-form ray-intersection equations.
